description: This file defines the UserSearch class for executing keyword searches on user data within a Drupal module, including methods for creating the search plugin, executing searches, access control, and help documentation.

classes.name: UserSearch
classes.description: A Drupal search plugin class for executing user keyword searches against the users database table.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the UserSearch plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as database, entity type manager, module handler, and current user.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access user profiles.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the user search based on keywords, returning matching user data with links.

methods.name: getHelp
methods.description: Provides help information about the user search functionality.
